news.title: SLU Professor Emerita Diana Carlin Honored with NAFSA's Leadership and Collaboration Award
news.summary_en: Diana B. Carlin, Ph.D., professor emerita of communication at Saint Louis University, is the 2026 NAFSA International Education Award for Leadership and Collaboration winner. The award given in honor of Cassandra Pyle, honors the contributions of an international educator to international exchange on a global scale.
